column4: One heavy step of wet rubber boots striding fast through long wet grass, an old woman's weight, a wicker basket creaks once, close, outdoors at night
One heavy squelching step of a rubber boot in soaked long grass, fast stride, close, outdoors at night
One quick heavy footstep in wet grass and mud, a rubber boot sucking out of the ground, close, outdoors at night
One heavy step in wet grass, rubber boot, the swish of a long dress against the grass, close, outdoors at night
One heavy quick step of a rubber boot on wet gravel, stones crunching, close, outdoors at night
One heavy step on a gravel path, rubber boot grinding small stones, close, outdoors at night
Slow wet rattling breathing of a very old woman through a mouth clogged with something soft, phlegm and fungus bubbling in the throat, close, horror, no words
A long wet sniffing of the air right beside the listener's ear, then a slow rattling exhale, horror, no words
A long chain of loud dry cracks like dead branches snapping, a spine straightening far too far, joints popping one after another, close, horror
A sudden burst of very fast heavy rubber boots through wet grass rushing straight at the listener, a wicker basket rattling violently, close
A small knife slicing through an ankle tendon, a wet elastic snap and a short tear of cloth, very close, horror
A person falling heavily face down into wet grass, the body thudding onto soft ground, close
Slow wet creaking and stretching of joints, an arm being pulled far too long, sinew creaking and small bones clicking, close, horror
A lamp post's bulb going dead, a soft electric fizz and the tick of a cooling filament, then silence, outdoors at night
A tent door zip pulled open slowly in the dark, a few metres away, outdoors at night
A knife ripping a long slit down nylon tent canvas, the fabric tearing in jerks, a few metres away, night
A knife blade prying at a wooden cabin door frame, wood creaking and splintering slowly, the latch rattling, a few metres away, night
A wooden door frame splitting open with a sharp crack and the door swinging inward on its hinges, a few metres away, night
A man woken in his tent with a short choked scream that is cut off at once, muffled through canvas, a few metres away, horror
A woman woken in her tent with a short choked scream that is cut off at once, muffled through canvas, a few metres away, horror
Slow wet munching and tearing of raw meat, small bones cracking now and then, slurping, a low contented humming under it, muffled inside a tent, horror
Wet chewing and sucking, flesh pulled apart, a bone snapped and gnawed, slow and greedy, muffled inside a small wooden cabin, horror
A single loud crack of a bone being bitten through, wet, close, horror
A dry dusty hiss of spores drifting in the air, soft papery puffs now and then, very close, airy and eerie, no wind
Slow heavy steps and a creaking wicker basket going away into a wet forest at dawn, fading into the distance
